parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp. The default value is the time of the API call.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description: This parameter is scheduled to be deprecated before 00:00:00 on June 30, 2021. The API for the account group feature that replaces this parameter will be available before 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. If you use this parameter, switch to the account group API after 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. For more information about account groups, see [Account groups](~~211534~~).

parameters.name: MultiAccount
parameters.description: This parameter is scheduled to be deprecated before 00:00:00 on June 30, 2021. The API for the account group feature that replaces this parameter will be available before 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. If you use this parameter, switch to the account group API after 00:00:00 on May 30, 2021. For more information about account groups, see [Account groups](~~211534~~).

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp. The default value is 30 days before the time of the API call.
